title: Roles & Permissions
description: Learn how to create custom roles, assign permissions, and control what users can access and modify in your account.
content:
Roles & Permissions

Create custom roles and assign granular permissions to control what users can access and modify in your Tijraa account.

Understanding Roles

Roles are collections of permissions that define what a user can do:

  • Predefined roles (Super Admin, Admin, Manager, Staff)
  • Custom roles
  • Role-based access control

Creating a Custom Role

Step 1: Access Roles

Navigate to Roles in your dashboard and click "Create Role".

Step 2: Role Information

Enter role details:

  • Role name
  • Description
  • Display name

Step 3: Assign Permissions

Select permissions for the role:

  • Browse available permissions
  • Select by category
  • Grant specific permissions

Step 4: Save Role

Click "Create Role" to save.

Permission Categories

Permissions are organized by category:

  • Dashboard
  • Stores
  • Products
  • Orders
  • Customers
  • Categories
  • Shipping
  • Coupons
  • Blog
  • Reviews
  • Analytics
  • POS
  • Settings
  • Users
  • Roles
  • Permissions

Permission Types

Each resource has permission types:

  • View: Read-only access
  • Create: Add new items
  • Edit: Modify existing items
  • Delete: Remove items
  • Manage: Full access
  • Export: Export data

Assigning Roles

Assign roles to users:

  • When creating users
  • When editing users
  • Bulk role assignment
  • Multiple roles per user

Managing Roles

Manage your roles:

  • Edit role permissions
  • Update role information
  • Delete roles
  • Duplicate roles
  • View role usage

Best Practices

  • Use principle of least privilege
  • Create role templates
  • Review permissions regularly
  • Document custom roles
  • Test roles before assigning
  • Keep roles organized

Related Guides
